integrity: One proved infinite theorem with explicit definitions, sharp attainment and standalone finite tests. No independent external validation or certification claimed.
limitations: Binary aperiodic fixed points only; equal-length Parikh-constant nonempty binary images with pointwise prefix dominance; no assertion for lengths shorter than the image or for other substitutions. An unindexed equivalent theorem may exist.
title: Exact residue-periodic abelian complexity under prefix-dominant Parikh-constant binary substitutions
